steps.title: Short-Hop
steps.sub: Pay by distance on the MBTA
steps.text: This is Short-Hop, the transit app that charges by distance.

steps.title: Set up in seconds
steps.text: Setup takes seconds. Add your name and pick your fare type. There's no sign-up bonus. You start at zero.

steps.title: Home
steps.sub: Balance · weekly fare cap · live alerts
steps.text: Home shows your balance, your weekly fare cap, and live MBTA service alerts.

steps.title: Add money
steps.text: Add a card, top up your balance, and turn on auto-reload so you're never stuck at the gate.

steps.title: Plan a trip
steps.text: Plan a trip. Copley to Arlington is one stop, about three percent of the line, so it's eighty cents, not two forty. Ride the whole line, and it's two forty, never more.

steps.title: Tap in
steps.text: Tap in, and your phone becomes the ticket. The QR code refreshes every thirty seconds.

steps.title: Tap out
steps.text: Tap out at Arlington, and you pay eighty cents. The fare follows the distance.

steps.title: Activity
steps.sub: What you saved vs the flat fare
steps.text: Every trip shows what you saved compared with the flat fare.

steps.title: Try it on your phone
steps.text: Try it on your phone. The link is in the post.
